name: Coconut Yogurt
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated for SIBO as it's naturally lactose-free and typically doesn't contain high FODMAP ingredients. Check labels for added inulin or other high FODMAP thickeners.
preparationTips: Check ingredient labels for added inulin, chicory root, or other high FODMAP additives
Choose plain varieties to avoid high FODMAP fruit additions
Look for products with live cultures for gut health benefits
Can be used as direct substitute for dairy yogurt in recipes
nutritionalHighlights: Often fortified with calcium and vitamin D
Lower protein than dairy yogurt but dairy-free
